grid.expression: SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, sum(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND CAB.CODEMP IN (1,2,501) AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI AND TRUNC(CAB.DTENTSAI) <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN AND CAB.CODTIPOPER IN (1100,2200,1111,1190,1124,1117,1116,2202) GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD
